title: The four-dimensional Sklyanin algebras revisited
summary: We give a theta-function and projective-geometric account of the four-dimensional Sklyanin algebras. We define a family of quadratic algebras by declaring that their relations are precisely the two-tensors vanishing on the graph of a translation automorphism on a quartic complex elliptic curve and the vertex pairs where the vertices are the singular points of the four singular quadrics that contain it.
